decks.notes: The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures through cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to control the game and protect the combo. With a mix of card draw, counterspells, and powerful reanimation spells, this deck aims to assemble its combo pieces efficiently and win the game through powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty.

The deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game quickly and decisively. It includes various cantrip spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to filter through the deck and find key pieces, disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo, and key combo pieces like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, Lotus Petal, and Doomsday itself. The goal is to set up a winning pile with Doomsday and Thassa's Oracle to win the game on the spot. The deck is built around speed, efficiency, and precision in executing the combo.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays supplemented by disruption and removal spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The deck employs a mix of efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and Orcish Bowmasters, along with powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, to quickly close out the game. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize allows for disruption of the opponent's game plan, while Goblin Bombardment helps to push through damage and break through stalemates. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent start to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then bringing them back onto the battlefield with spells like Reanimate. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo. The goal is to efficiently and effectively reanimate big threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty to overwhelm the opponent and win the game quickly. With a mix of control elements and powerful threats, the deck aims to quickly execute its combo and secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands as the main control strategy, using cards like Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create powerful token creatures. Cards like Life from the Loam and Exploration help accelerate land plays, while also disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Wasteland and Maze of Ith. The deck also includes utility lands like Karakas and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to further control the board. With the ability to search for key lands using cards like Crop Rotation and Expedition Map, the deck aims to control the game by leveraging its land advantage.

This deck focuses on using lands as control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building towards a powerful win condition. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Dark Depths, Thespian's Stage, and Life from the Loam to create a powerful Marit Lage token while also using cards like Wasteland and The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale to disrupt the opponent's mana base and creatures. The deck aims to control the game through land manipulation and denial, while setting up a game-winning threat with the Marit Lage token.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Animate Dead and Shallow Grave. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck aims to win the game as quickly as possible by reanimating powerful threats and overwhelming the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on cheating out powerful, game-ending creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier through the use of Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. This combo strategy aims to overwhelm opponents with massive threats early in the game, often bypassing traditional summoning costs. The deck also includes various counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo pieces and disrupt opponents' plans. Additionally, cards like Omniscience and Stock Up provide additional ways to ramp and draw cards to further support the combo strategy.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly get out powerful creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience to cast big spells for free and protection spells like Force of Will to protect your combo. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with big threats early in the game and win before they have a chance to react.

The deck focuses on playing powerful spells for free using Show and Tell and Omniscience, leading to a quick victory by putting Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield. The deck also includes Lórien Revealed for additional card draw and protection spells such as Force of Will and Spell Pierce to defend against disruption. The strategy revolves around assembling the key combo pieces efficiently and protecting them until victory can be achieved. The deck utilizes cantrips like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary cards and Cunning Wish to access sideboard options for specific matchups. It aims to win the game decisively and quickly through its powerful combo potential.

This control deck focuses on manipulating the opponent's game plan through counterspells and removal spells while also utilizing Leyline cards to disrupt their strategy. The deck includes a mix of efficient interaction like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares, along with card advantage engines like Brainstorm and Ponder. The inclusion of Leyline of the Guildpact and Leyline Binding helps to maintain control of the board while Scion of Draco serves as a powerful win condition. The mana base is designed to support casting spells of various colors efficiently.

This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures and then bring them back onto the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy revolves around using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize to set up the graveyard while controlling the opponent's plays with counterspells like Force of Will and Daze. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent, making it a versatile and powerful combo-reanimator deck that can quickly overwhelm opponents with its big threats.

The deck focuses on using various forms of card advantage and disruption to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. It utilizes spells like Brainstorm, Entomb, Thoughtseize, and Reanimate to set up and execute its combo plays, while also including countermagic like Daze and Force of Will to protect its strategy. The deck also includes Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent as additional threats and disruption. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan.

The deck revolves around quickly milling your entire library into the graveyard and then winning the game through a combo finish. By utilizing cards like Undercity Informer and Balustrade Spy, you are able to put all of your nonland cards into your graveyard. This strategy is supported by cards like Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle which can trigger special effects when drawn from the graveyard. The deck also includes various ways to protect your combo, such as Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy, ensuring that you can execute your game plan successfully.

The deck focuses on a disruptive aggro strategy with Death & Taxes archetype, utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's board while deploying threats like Stoneforge Mystic and Recruiter of the Guard to pressure the opponent. The deck also includes interaction with Aether Vial and Containment Priest to disrupt opponent's strategies. With the inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck aims to maximize value through flickering creatures and controlling the game tempo.

The deck focuses on using a combination of reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent into play from the graveyard. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the game and protect its key combo pieces. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan. Its strategy revolves around leveraging the graveyard as a resource and using efficient spells to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent.
